As the weather cools off and the fall outdoor season ramps up, I tend to tweak my everyday carry list to match how I ams spending my time. The Pelican MagSafe Wallet & Card Holder is my go-to option when you want something a little more rugged that can handle the outdoors but still works as a great everyday wallet.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers looks at the latest and greatest in the MagSafe and wireless charging industry to help you get the most out of your Apple devices that support wireless charging.

Perfect for outdoor activities

The Pelican wallet is IPX4 water-resistant, which means if you get it wet on a hike or at the lake, it won’t get your credit cards or cash wet. Once it snaps shut, it stays shut. For example, I go to plenty of Falcons games during the fall, and even at football games, I like knowing everything is closed and locked in. That alone makes it a solid pick for fall outdoor activities when the weather can change quickly. It feels more like a tiny hard shell case than a wallet that happens to snap onto your iPhone.

Most MagSafe wallets are designed for a few cards and nothing else. Pelican’s design gives you a little more flexibility. It easily holds an ID and credit cards, and there is also space for some folded cash and a small key. If you want to keep things minimal on a hike, this wallet covers the basics without needing to bring a separate bag.

While the Pelican wallet is great for outdoor use, it is just as useful for everyday carry. Strong magnets attach it securely to the back of your iPhone, and the snap closure means nothing falls out. Compared to less durable MagSafe wallets, this one trades a little bit of slimness for a lot more peace of mind. It’s probably not what I’d reach for in the summer when I want something more minimal, but for hiking, football games, and anything where I am on the go outside and the weather might change, it’s the right call. It’s a great MagSafe wallet for kids with their first iPhone as well. My oldest son has used it for years as well.

Wrap up on Pelican MagSafe Wallet

The Pelican MagSafe Wallet is built for people who prioritize durability. It keeps your essentials safe from the weather and water, carries just enough for a hike or a day trip, and snaps securely in place. If you want a MagSafe wallet that can withstand falls and still work day-to-day, this is it.

You can buy the Pelican MagSafe Wallet from Amazon or directly from Pelican.
